source: 775 Cunning
target: 775 Calliditas

source: As the goat-faced Devil approached and stared at him, Lumian’s hand was already gripping the hilt of the Sword of Courage.
target: Cum diabolus, vultu caprino, accedebat et eum intuebatur, manus Lumiani iam manubrium Gladii Fortitudinis tenebat.

source: When the white bone leg came crashing down, he swiftly drew the iron-black sword, burning with a bright white and blue flame, and met the attack head-on.
target: Cum crus ossis album in terram ruina cecidit, celeriter traxit gladium ferri–nigerum, qui flammis albis et caeruleis nitidissimis ardebant, et impetum directe oppugnavit.

source: Clang!
target: Clang!

source: The clash echoed loudly, and Lumian’s palm split open, spilling blackened, coagulated blood.
target: Conflagra–tio sonum magnopere edidit, et palma Lumiani rupta est, effundens sanguinem atratum et coagulatum.

source: The immense force from the goat-faced Demon’s strike made him lose his grip on the Sword of Courage, sending him flying and crashing into a pile of rubble.
target: Immensus vis ictus daemonis, vultu caprino, fecit ut manus illum de Gladio Fortitudinis amitteret, eumque volitare atque in acervum ruinarum corruere faceret.

source: The goat-faced Demon stepped over the fallen sword in two strides, standing before Lumian and raising the bone leg again.
target: Daemon, vultu caprino, in duobus passibus gladium lapsum transgressus est, coram Lumiano stans et crus ossis denuo attollens.

source: Suddenly, in its blood- and pus-filled eyes, the figure of Sharron, the temperance faction demigod, appeared. Its raised hands froze in midair.
target: Subito, in oculis eius sanguine et purulento plenis, figura Sharronis, semidei factionis temperantiae, apparuit. Manus eius attollitae in aere congelatae erant.

source: Seeing the goat-faced Demon’s movements slow down as if struggling against something, Lumian ignited with white flames, transforming into a spear and darting past the high-ranking undead to where the Sword of Courage had fallen.
target: Videns daemonis, vultu caprino, motus tardari quasi aliquid oppugnari, Lumian ignibus albis exarduit, in hastam se transformans atque praeter praestantes redivivos evolans ad locum, ubi Gladius Fortitudinis cecidit.

source: Perhaps because the goat-faced Demon wasn’t an undead created by the Death pathway, its intimidating effect on Lumian was weak.
target: Forsitan quod daemon, vultu caprino, non esset redivivus per viam Mortis creatus, effectus eius intimidans in Lumiano debilis fuit.

source: It lacked the ability to enslave his body and mind, allowing Lumian to muster the courage to fight back.
target: Non habebat facultatem subigere corpus eius et mentem, ita Lumiano concessum est virtutem colligere ad repugnandum.

source: While retrieving the iron-black broadsword, Lumian released the spirituality he had accumulated using his Ascetic ability.
target: Dum gladius ferri–niger reciperetur, Lumian spiritualitatem, quam per potentiam asceticam suam congregaverat, dimisit.

source: At the same time, his eyes turned iron-black, reflecting the many colors on the goat-faced Demon.
target: Simul, oculi eius in ferrum nigrum versati sunt, multa colora in daemon, vultu caprino, reflectentes.

source: He quickly found a patch of pallor, took two steps towards the goat-faced Demon, and leaped high.
target: Celeriter locum palloris invenit, duos gradus in directionem daemonis, vultu caprino, fecit, et alte salivit.

source: In midair, Lumian adjusted his posture, gripping the Sword of Courage with both hands and descending towards the slow-moving Demon, still battling Sharron.
target: In aere, Lumian statum corporis sui componebat, Gladium Fortitudinis utrisque manibus tenens et ad daemonem tarditer movens descendebat, Sharron adhuc pugnans.

source: This time, he used the Sword of Courage’s Cull ability!
target: Hoc tempore, usus est facultate “Cull” Gladii Fortitudinis!

source: His spirituality surged into the iron-black broadsword, causing the bright white and blue flames to flare up and then condense inward.
target: Spiritualitas eius in gladium ferri–nigerum impetum fecit, ut flammae albae et caeruleae nitidae exarduerent atque deinde in se congregarentur.

source: With a heavy thud, Lumian landed on the Demon’s back, stabbing the Sword of Courage into the junction of its neck and body. The blade sliced into the decayed flesh like butter.
target: Gravi iactu, Lumian in tergo daemonis decessit, Gladium Fortitudinis in iuncturam colli et corporis infigens. Lamina in carne putida ut butyrum incidit.

source: As pus splattered, the flames on the broadsword poured into the goat-faced Demon’s body.
target: Dum pus spargebatur, flammae in gladio ferri–niger in corpus daemonis, vultu caprino, effundebantur.

source: Boom! A muffled explosion echoed, and Sharron quickly withdrew from the Demon’s body.
target: Boom! Explosio submissa resonavit, et Sharron celeriter a corpore daemonis recedebat.

source: The Demon disintegrated into a puddle of sticky black liquid, condensed from evil thoughts.
target: Daemon in guttam liquoris nigri viscosi, ex malis cogitationibus condensati, disgregatus est.

source: The liquid, scattered by the expanding flames and shockwaves, swiftly flowed into the dark hole leading to the Pale-white Nation, seemingly to reassemble itself.
target: Liquidum, a flammis expansis et undis concussis dispersum, celeriter in cavum obscurum, quod ad Nationem Pallidam Albam duxit, fluebat, quasi se iterum coalescere vellet.

source: Holding the Sword of Courage, Lumian felt his released spirituality deplete by two-thirds.
target: Gladium Fortitudinis tenens, Lumian sensit spiritualitatem suam dimissam esse per duas partes ex tribus.

source: He wanted to chase and fight the Demon again but felt his body stiffen and his soul trapped in an invisible cage.
target: Daemonem iterum persequi et pugnare vellebat, sed sensit corpus rigide fieri et animam in invisibili cavea inclusam.

source: “Retrieve your target item first,” the faint voice of the Knight of Swords echoed in his ears.
target: “Recupera primum rem propositam tuam,” vox tenue Eques Gladii in auribus eius resonabat.

source: Right… Lumian agreed with the Knight of Swords’ reasoning.
target: Recte… Lumian ratione Eques Gladii assensit.

source: I don’t fear the goat-faced Demon. I can totally grab the Abscessed Hand’s body before it reassembles!
target: Daemonem, vultu caprino, non timeo. Possum plane corpus Manus Abscessae arripere antequam se iterum congreget.

source: He transformed into a burning-white spear, darting to the bone torches.
target: Se in hastam albe ardentem transformavit, festinans ad faces ossium.

source: To better move the Abscessed Hand’s body, he temporarily stashed the Sword of Courage in the Traveler’s Bag.
target: Ut corpus Manus Abscessae melius moveret, Gladium Fortitudinis pro tempore in sacculo Viatoris recondidit.

source: Moments later, Lumian felt a pang of fear: I only have a third of my spirituality left, yet I was thinking of a life-or-death fight with the Demon?
target: Paulis post, Lumian angorem timoris sensit: solam tertiam partem spiritualitatis suae remanere; et tamen de pugna inter vitam et mortem cum daemon cogitabatur?

source: And Sharron is clearly in poor condition!
target: Et Sharron plane in paupera condicione versatur!

source: Now isn’t the time for that. Shouldn’t I grab the target item and leave the collapsing cathedral before the Demon reassembles?
target: Nunc non est tempus ad hoc. Num oportet me rem propositam arripere et cathedralem corruentem relinquere antequam daemon se iterum congreget?

source: Thankfully, the Knight of Swords acted as a valve for my courage and found a convincing reason!
target: Gratias Deo, Eques Gladii instar moderatoris virtutis meae egit et rationem persuasivam invenit!

source: Without hesitation, Lumian grasped the Abscessed Hand’s half-body, trying to lift it.
target: Sine dubitatione, Lumian dimidium corporis Manus Abscessae arripuit, conans illud sublevare.

source: It was extremely heavy, like metal. Fortunately, Lumian was now a Sequence 5 Beyonder, from a pathway known for their strength.
target: Valde grave erat, sicut metallum. Fortunate, Lumian nunc erat Sequence V Beyonder, ex via notissima propter virtutem.

source: During this process, Lumian worried the body might suddenly reanimate and deliver a fatal blow.
target: Durante hoc processu, Lumian sollicite cogitabat ne corpus repente reanimi fieret et ictum letalem daret.

source: However, the Abscessed Hand’s half-body, after enduring years of cutting by the goat-faced Demon, seemed lifeless with no abnormal reaction.
target: Tamen, dimidium corporis Manus Abscessae, post annos vulnerum a daemon, vultu caprino inflictorum, iners apparuit, sine ullo motu anomalo.

source: Lumian placed the half–corpse into the Traveler’s Bag, relieved to see it “sink” inside.
target: Lumian dimidium cadaveris in sacculo Viatoris posuit, levatus quod illud intus submergeretur.

source: Living flesh couldn’t be stored in the Traveler’s Bag, and the Abscessed Hand’s body had shown self–healing traits earlier.
target: Carne viva in sacculo Viatoris condiri non potuit, et corpus Manus Abscessae antehac qualitates auto–sanationis ostendit.

source: Lumian had thought if he couldn’t store it, he’d carry it or have the Knight of Swords or Sharron possess it to make it move.
target: Lumian putavit, si id condere non posset, vel portaturum esse, vel Eques Gladii aut Sharron illud possiderent ad eius movendum.

source: With the body stored, Lumian heard creaking sounds from the dark hole.
target: Corpus repositum, Lumian sonos crepitantes ex cavum obscurum audivit.

source: He immediately transformed into a blazing spear, darting out of the half–collapsed pitch–black cathedral.
target: Statim se in hastam flagrans transformavit, ex cathedral dimidio corruente et prorsus nigro expellens.

source: With a swoosh, the white flames left a burning trail in the dark, spreading quickly into the distance.
target: Cum sibilo, flammae albae vestigium ardentem in tenebris reliquerunt, celeriter in longinquitatem diffundentes.

source: Without the Pale–White Nation’s erosion, Lumian flew far in one breath.
target: Absque erosionem Nationis Pallidae Albam, Lumian uno spiritu longe volavit.

source: Under the golden humanoid lamplights, he repeatedly transformed into a blazing spear, finally reaching the shadowy River Styx.
target: Sub aureis lampadis humanoidibus, iterum atque iterum se in hastam flagrans transformabat, denique flumen Styx umbratile attingens.

source: He saw the gloomy, tattered boat reappear, slowly approaching as the boatman rowed.
target: Vidit navem tristem, laceratam iterum apparire, paulatim accedens dum nauta remigabat.

source: Lumian waited anxiously, not daring to fly onto the boat as a spear.
target: Lumian anxie exspectabat, non ausus ut se in navem, ut hasta similis, volitaret.

source: According to the Knight of Swords Maric, doing so would make him sink into the river’s depths, never to be saved.
target: Secundum Equem Gladii Maric, hoc faciens eum in profundum fluminis submergere faceret, nunquamque servatum esse.

source: Behind him, pale green flames burned quietly, sometimes swaying with the ground’s tremors, sometimes shaking with some vibrations.
target: Post eum, flammae virides pallidae quiete ardebant, interdum tremore terrae oscillantes, interdum vibrationibus aliquantulis commoventes.

source: Lumian tensed, feeling an increasing danger, unsure if it was from the ancient Death’s corpse awakening or the goat-faced Demon’s pursuit.
target: Lumian tensus est, percipiens periculum augmentum, nescio utrum ex evigilatione cadaveris Mortis antiquae vel ex insequentia daemonis, vultu caprino proveniret.

source: He looked at the slow–moving boat, using a Hunter’s method to calm his emotions.
target: Contemplatus est navem tarditer moventem, utens more venatoris ad animi sui sedandum.

source: He chuckled and spoke to the Knight of Swords Maric within him, “I thought the goat–faced Demon was powerful, just below the ancient gods, holding a grudge against the Devil Monarch and desiring the egg beneath the ancient Death’s corpse. But now, it seems it’s just at the Saint level, with only a corpse left, lacking Beyonder characteristics.”
target: Subridens locutus est ad Equem Gladii Maric, qui intra eum habitat, “Putabam daemonem, vultu caprino, esse potentem, paene deorum antiquorum infra, rancorem gerens adversus Monarcham Diaboli et ovum sub cadavere Mortis antiquae desiderare. Sed nunc videtur solum ad gradum Sancti esse, solo cadavro relicto, carens proprietatibus Beyonder.”

source: The Knight of Swords didn’t respond.
target: Eques Gladii non respondit.

source: Lumian continued, “The goat–faced Demon’s initial request to kill the Devil Monarch was likely a bluff, making us more likely to accept the second condition, thinking it reasonable. If Oxyto’s premature child hadn’t interfered, we might have stolen the egg, only to face the ancient Death’s wrath, unrelated to the goat–faced Demon.
target: Lumian continuavit: “Petitum initium daemonis, vultu caprino, ad occidendum Monarcham Diaboli probabiliter erat fictio, quae nos ad aliam condicionem accipiendam inclinavit, id rationabile existimantes. Si filius prae–maturus Oxyto non intercessisset, fortasse ovum surripivissemus, ut contra iram Mortis antiquae pugnaremus, quae daemoni, vultu caprino, non pertinebat.

source: It also used the request to kill the Devil Monarch to build its image, making us think it was formidable, of high rank, preventing us from attacking it or abandoning the egg task.
target: Etiam postulatum ad occidendum Monarcham Diaboli ad imaginem suam constituendam utebatur, nos efficere faciens ut putaremus eum formidolosum et excelsum, ne ab illo oppugnarent aut officium ovum neglegerent.

source: What a cunning Demon…
target: O quam callidum daemonem…

source: Lumian then remembered the demon’s accusation: “You’ve taken that egg for yourself!”
target: Tum Lumian daemonis accusationem retulit: “Ipsum ovum tibi ceperis!”

source: When did I take the egg? It’s still under the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse. I only resonated with the creature inside, hearing and seeing what it did… Did the Demon mistake this resonance for me taking and breaking the egg? As an undead, even if it was a Saint–level Demon in life, it might have little brain left, acting on its cunning Demonic instinct…
target: Quando ovum ceperim? Illud adhuc sub cadavere Phoenix Avus manet. Ego solum cum creatura intima resonavi, audiens et videns quid faceret… Num daemon hanc resonantiam pro eo confudit, ut ovum ceperim et confractum fecerim? Ut redivivus, etiamsi in vita daemon gradus Sancti fuerit, parvum cerebrum reliquum habere poterat, agens ex suo callido instinctu daemonico…

source: As Lumian pondered, the tattered boat finally reached the shore.
target: Dum Lumian meditabatur, navis lacerata denique litus attingebat.

source: He jumped aboard, standing behind the boatman.
target: In navem insilivit, stans post nauta.

source: Though the boatman might attack later, compared to the goat–faced Demon’s pursuit and the ancient Death’s corpse’s awakening, it was “friendly.”
target: Quamquam nauta postea oppugnare posset, comparato insequentia daemonis, vultu caprino, et evigilatione cadaveris Mortis antiquae, amicus videbatur.

source: This was manageable.
target: Hoc tolerabile erat.

source: The rickety boat shook as it left the dark shore, slowly heading towards the middle of the shadowy river.
target: Navis labile concutiebatur dum litus obscurum relinquebat, lente versus medium fluminis umbratilis se vertens.

source: Lumian looked back at the depths of the Underworld, seeing the intense darkness calm down, no more tremors or heavy sounds.
target: Lumian ad profunda Inferorum respexit, qua intensae tenebrae sedaverunt, nec iam tremores aut sonitus graves resonabant.

source: Everything was serene again.
target: Omnia iterum tranquilla erant.

source: Lumian relaxed a bit, instinctively sighing.
target: Lumian paululum relaxatus est, instinctu suspirans.

source: This Underworld trip was indeed “intense”…
target: Haec iter Inferorum vere “intensa” fuit…

source: Only now did he ponder the huge black egg issue: The creature inside seemed related to Omebella!
target: Modo nunc de ingenti ovo nigro quaestionem meditatus est: creatura intima ad Omebella pertinere videbatur!

source: From this, Lumian felt the Great Mother naming Her Child of God after the ancient god, Omebella, wasn’t just for symbolic reasons to erode the Earth Mother’s authority. The fallen Goddess of Harvest held significant secrets.
target: Ex hoc, Lumian sensit Magnum Matrem, Filium Dei in honorem dei antiquae, Omebella, nominare non solum propter rationes symbolicas ad auctoritatem Matris Terrae subruendam esse. Dea Messis decidua secreta gravia tenebat.

source: But Omebella wasn’t one of the eight ancient gods ruling the sky and land, just the Giant King’s queen, akin to an Angel. How can Her secrets affect the current era?
target: Sed Omebella non erat una ex octo deis antiquorum, qui caelum et terram regebant, sed sola regina Regis Gigantis, quasi Angelus. Quomodo eius secreta aetatem hodiernam afficere possunt?

source: Ah, many key pieces of information are obscured by history’s fog. Only a few high–ranking beings from the Second Epoch know a bit…
target: Ah, multae res clavis ab historiae nebula obscuratae sunt. Pauci tantum entia summa dignitatis ex Secunda Aetate parum scire videntur…

source: Lumian mused as he watched the dark land of the Underworld recede, until only the shadowy River Styx water filled his view.
target: Lumian meditatus est dum terram obscuram Inferorum recedere videbat, donec solum umbratile flumen Styx totam visionem eius implevit.

source: He suddenly felt the matter had finally come to an end.
target: Subito sensit rem denique finem attigerit.
